en: Black‑and‑white image showing a romantic historicist villa or small castle with a tall, slender spire and a round turret, set on a wooded slope above a broad dirt promenade. A long stairway climbs the hill beside the building, and a wooden fence lines the path. In the foreground, a few people in early‑20th‑century clothing walk along the road. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.
